subject: EB readiness: sponsor grid, MAP template, and proposed EB windows
messages:
From: Karen Li <karen.li@acmecorp.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-06-01T08:15:00Z
Subject: MAP & EB — initial ask and timelines

Thanks Chloe — following up from our call this morning. We need a mutual action plan (MAP) and a 60–90 minute executive briefing (EB) as part of our internal evaluation / close timeline. Key asks:
- Acme will run an evaluation week of June 14–18; we want an EB that week or the following to present to the steering committee.
- MAP should include milestone owners, gating criteria, and a short success rubric tied to performance (latency/cost) and security posture.
- Procurement needs to confirm DocuSign dates and any required contract redlines before June 25.

Attached: Acme-eval-criteria.pdf (pdf, 240KB)

Can you share your MAP template and propose 2 EB windows (one during evaluation week and one fallback)? Also, we’ll need an exec sponsor list from Redwood for the EB (title-level mapping: CTO/VP Engineering).

Thanks,
Karen
Karen Li
Head of Platform Strategy
Acme Corp
[Attachment: Acme-eval-criteria.pdf (pdf, 240KB)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP & EB — initial ask and timelines

Hi Karen — thanks for the clear list. Quick response with an initial package: 1) Attached is our Redwood MAP template populated with a draft timeline and owners; 2) Proposed EB windows; 3) a short EB agenda (v1). Highlights below:

Draft MAP highlights (attached Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx):
- Phase 1 (Eval prep): dataset access + security review — owner: Karthik Iyer (Solutions)
- Phase 2 (Week of eval): live eval support + perf snapshot — owner: Chloe Martin (AE)
- Phase 3 (EB + purchase): exec briefing, procurement signoff, PO/DocuSign — owner: Ben Carter (Sales)

Proposed EB windows (pick one):
- Option A: Thu, Jun 17, 10:00–11:30 PT (during eval week)
- Option B: Tue, Jun 22, 14:00–15:30 PT (fallback)

EB attendees we recommend from Redwood:
- Laura Bennett — VP, Customer Success (exec sponsor)
- Karthik Iyer — Solutions Lead (technical exec lead)
- Ben Carter — Account Executive (commercials, next steps)

I’ve attached a short EB-Agenda-v2.pdf and a populated MAP spreadsheet (v1). If those windows work, we’ll send calendar holds and a short pre-read.

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx (xlsx, 110KB); EB-Agenda-v2.pdf (pdf, 95KB)

Best,
Chloe Martin

chloe.martin@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0112
